title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 37 - Public Utilities, Chapter 3 - Rates, Interchange of Services and Safety, Article 1 - In General
source_id: Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 37, ch. 3, art. 1 (ss 37-3-101 through 37-3-119)
verified_how: walked the LSO NXT table of contents (gateway.dll?f=xmlcontents&command=getchildren) down to 'TITLE 37 - PUBLIC UTILITIES' > 'CHAPTER 3 - RATES, INTERCHANGE OF SERVICES AND SAFETY' > 'ARTICLE 1 - IN GENERAL', opening '37-3-101. Rates to be just, reasonable and uniform; exceptions.' and '37-3-102. Only prescribed rates to be charged.' and ending '37-3-119. Apportionment of costs to Wyoming ratepayers.' ('37-3-103. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 192, s 3.' confirms the register flags repeals inline). Repealed sections are shown in the same listing with a 'Repealed by Laws ...' catchline (e.g. '37-3-103. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 192, s 3.'), so the substantive catchlines above are live text. Currency: the LSO's Statutes Download page states 'This version of the Wyoming Statutes contains changes from the 2026 Budget Session and reflects the contents of the statutes as they exist as of July 1, 2026'; the NXT infobase I browsed is the one labelled '2026 Wyoming Statutes' (the register also keeps 2020-2025 as separate historical infobases). Official title PDF at https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title37.pdf.
notes: What a regulated utility may charge a customer, and the bar on charging anything other than the filed tariff. The Public Service Commission itself is ch. 2; the chapter's other articles are art. 2 Natural Gas Storage Limits and Rates, art. 3 High Voltage Line Safety and art. 4 Wildfire Mitigation. Billing mechanics, deposits and disconnection are in PSC rules rather than statute.
